name: Persona
summary: A person: an Avatar or a presence badge beside up to four lines of text, the name first. Use it in lists, headers and pickers; an Avatar alone is the picture without the text.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The person's name, passed to the avatar for its initials and colour, and shown as the primary text when no primaryText slot is given.

inputs.name: primaryText
inputs.description: The first line, body1 in Foreground 1.

inputs.name: secondaryText
inputs.description: The second line, caption1 in Foreground 2, pulled up 2px.

inputs.name: tertiaryText
inputs.description: The third line, caption1 in Foreground 2.

inputs.name: quaternaryText
inputs.description: The fourth line, caption1 in Foreground 2.

inputs.name: avatar
inputs.description: The Avatar; sized by the persona's size and given the name.

inputs.name: presence
inputs.description: A PresenceBadge, shown on the avatar, or alone when presenceOnly.

inputs.name: presenceOnly
inputs.description: Draws the presence badge in place of the avatar.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: The avatar's size step (20, 28, 32, 36, 40, 56px through the Avatar) and the gap to the text.

inputs.name: textPosition
inputs.description: Where the text sits relative to the media.

inputs.name: textAlignment
inputs.description: start aligns the media to the top of the text block; center centres it.

anatomy.name: Persona
anatomy.description: An inline grid: a max-content media column and an auto text column (reversed for before, stacked for below), rows of max-content, items justified start.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.description: The media, spanning every text row (five, or six when centred) with the size's spacing on the side facing the text.

anatomy.name: Presence
anatomy.description: The presence badge in the media column when presenceOnly, with SNudge spacing at small and the size's otherwise; with start alignment at sizes up to large it aligns to the primary line instead of spanning.

anatomy.name: Primary text
anatomy.description: body1 in Foreground 1, block; subtitle2 at extra-large and huge, and caption1 for a one-line presence-only extra-small persona.

anatomy.name: Secondary text
anatomy.description: caption1 in Foreground 2, block, pulled up 2px; body1 at huge with an avatar.

variants.description: Media left, text right; the media's spacing is a right margin.
Text left, media right, items justified end; the media's spacing is a left margin.
Media above the text, everything centred; the media's spacing is a bottom margin.
The media aligns to the top of the text; a presence-only badge at sizes up to large aligns to the primary line.
The media centres against the text block through a row template with 1fr rows above and below the four text rows.
SNudge spacing; a one-line presence-only persona reads caption1.
MNudge spacing; the primary line is subtitle2.
M spacing; the primary line is subtitle2 and, with an avatar, the optional lines body1.

layout.text: The root is an inline grid with auto-flow column, max-content rows and columns max-content then auto (auto then max-content for before, none for below); the media spans five rows, or six when text is centred, where the template adds a 1fr row above and below the four named text rows.

The gap between media and text is a margin on the media in the direction of the text: SNudge at extra-small, S at small and medium, MNudge at large and extra-large, M at huge; a presence-only small persona uses SNudge.

The primary line is body1 Foreground 1 and the others caption1 Foreground 2, each a block; the second line is pulled up 2px; at extra-large and huge the primary is subtitle2, at huge with an avatar the other lines are body1, and a one-line presence-only extra-small persona's primary is caption1.

A presence-only persona with start alignment at sizes below extra-large aligns its badge to the primary line: the badge is centred in the first row and the text occupies the column after (or before) the middle line.

states.text: A persona has no interaction states of its own; its avatar and any surrounding control carry them.

behaviour.text: Nothing animates; the avatar's own active ring and the presence badge follow their specs.

semantics: the avatar is labelled by the name and the presence badge by its status; the text lines are plain text read in order

notes.text: The -2px second-line pull-up and the row template are constants; every spacing is a token.
The avatar's pixel size per persona size (20, 28, 32, 36, 40, 56px) is set by the persona hook, not the styles file; avatar.json's size ramp is what it maps onto.
